exam_variants.format_stated: 50-60 multiple choice and multiple select questions
exam_variants.delivery_stated: a. Take the online-proctored exam from a remote location. Review the online testing requirements. b. Take the onsite-proctored exam at a testing center. Locate a test center near you - search for Google Cloud.

objectives.text: Differentiate between different data manipulation methodologies (e.g., ETL, ELT, ETLT)
Choose the appropriate data transfer tool (e.g., Storage Transfer Service, Transfer Appliance)
Assess data quality
Conduct data cleaning (e.g., Cloud Data Fusion, BigQuery, SQL, Dataflow)

subsections.title: Extract and load data into appropriate Google Cloud storage systems.

objectives.text: Distinguish the format of the data (e.g., CSV, JSON, Apache Parquet, Apache Avro, structured database tables)
Choose the appropriate extraction tool (e.g., Dataflow, BigQuery Data Transfer Service, Database Migration Service, Cloud Data Fusion)
Select the appropriate storage solution (e.g., Cloud Storage, BigQuery, Cloud SQL, Firestore, Bigtable, Spanner)

children.text: Choose the appropriate data storage location type (e.g., regional, dual-regional, multi-regional, zonal)
Classify use cases into having structured, unstructured, or semi-structured data requirements

objectives.text: Load data into Google Cloud storage systems using the appropriate tool (e.g., gcloud and BQ CLI, Storage Transfer Service, BigQuery Data Transfer Service, client libraries)

subsections.title: Identify data trends, patterns, and insights by using BigQuery and Jupyter notebooks.

objectives.text: Define and execute SQL queries in BigQuery to generate reports and extract key insights
Use Jupyter notebooks to analyze and visualize data (e.g., Colab Enterprise)
Analyze data to answer business questions

subsections.title: Visualize data and create dashboards in Looker given business requirements.

objectives.text: Create, modify, and share dashboards to answer business questions
Compare Looker and Looker Studio for different analytics use cases
Manipulate simple LookML parameters to modify a data model

subsections.title: Define, train, evaluate, and use ML models.

objectives.text: Identify ML use cases for developing models by using BigQuery ML and AutoML
Use pretrained Google large language models (LLMs) using remote connection in BigQuery
Plan a standard ML project (e.g., data collection, model training, model evaluation, prediction)
Execute SQL to create, train, and evaluate models using BigQuery ML
Perform inference using BigQuery ML models
Organize models in Model Registry

subsections.title: Design and implement simple data pipelines.

objectives.text: Select a data transformation tool (e.g., Dataproc, Dataflow, Cloud Data Fusion, Cloud Composer, Dataform) based on business requirements
Evaluate use cases for ELT and ETL
Choose products required to implement basic transformation pipelines

subsections.title: Schedule, automate, and monitor basic data processing tasks.

objectives.text: Create and manage scheduled queries (e.g., BigQuery, Cloud Scheduler, Cloud Composer)
Monitor Dataflow pipeline progress using the Dataflow job UI
Review and analyze logs in Cloud Logging and Cloud Monitoring
Select a data orchestration solution (e.g., Cloud Composer, scheduled queries, Dataproc Workflow Templates, Workflows) based on business requirements
Identify use cases for event-driven data ingestion from Pub/Sub to BigQuery
Use Eventarc triggers in event-driven pipelines (Dataform, Dataflow, Cloud Functions, Cloud Run, Cloud Composer)
Establish the principles of least privileged access by using Identity and Access Management (IAM)

children.text: Differentiate between basic roles, predefined roles, and permissions for data services (e.g., BigQuery, Cloud Storage)

objectives.text: Compare methods of access control for Cloud Storage (e.g., public or private access, uniform access)
Determine when to share data using Analytics Hub
Determine the appropriate Cloud Storage classes based on the frequency of data access and retention requirements
Configure rules to delete objects after a specified period to automatically remove unnecessary data and reduce storage expenses (e.g., BigQuery, Cloud Storage)
Evaluate Google Cloud services for archiving data given business requirements

subsections.title: Identify high availability and disaster recovery strategies for data in Cloud Storage and Cloud SQL.

objectives.text: Compare backup and recovery solutions offered as Google-managed services
Determine when to use replication
Distinguish between primary and secondary data storage location type (e.g., regions, dual-regions, multi-regions, zones) for data redundancy

subsections.title: Apply security measures and ensure compliance with data privacy regulations.

objectives.text: Identify use cases for customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK), customer-supplied encryption keys (CSEK), and Google-managed encryption keys (GMEK)
Understand the role of Cloud Key Management Service (Cloud KMS) to manage encryption keys
Identify the difference between encryption in transit and encryption at rest
